title: Database Deadlocks: Causes and Prevention
realWorldScenario: In a peer-to-peer payment app, User A transfers $50 to User B at the exact same millisecond that User B transfers $30 to User A. The application server logs: `ERROR: deadlock detected`.
questionStatement: What causes a database Deadlock? How does PostgreSQL detect and break deadlocks? What is the golden rule for preventing them in application code?
hints: If both transactions always lock account IDs in numerical order, can a cycle form?
